overview:
Level with Spectral Throw, then use a compatible claw for Elemental Hit. The included progression runs through the campaign.

Source guide by POE Thysaster: https://pobarchives.com/build/pfwEWEej
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/_5wKrWwebsY3

Passive trees converted with the 3.30 PoB development build. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
